Home workout app
Walking trend goes zoom.
Is it overhyped? Probably by some people. Just about every trend has some hype. I'm a bit skeptical that it'll burn 300-400 calories, but maybe if we're relatively heavy and go pretty fast.
However, if you're looking for a cool variation to your walking that you can do in about 30 minutes (and allows you to do stuff while you walk!), then it can be a nice thing to try.
